prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-screen background for the private card collection of a high-quality Gothic medieval fantasy RPG website. Create a richly crafted, believable collector's writing chamber in a modest wealthy Gothic manor, visually matching a rustic fantasy shop: rough charcoal stone, dark oak joinery, antiquarian leather books, restrained brass details, tiny candle pools of amber light and faint cool moonlight. View from the seated visitor towards a broad dark wooden card-table in foreground, a low cabinet and arched window farther back. Composition is a wide 16:9 landscape: practical visual negative space across the entire middle 70 percent for UI, dark legible low-contrast grain there; details and visual storytelling concentrated along extreme left and right edges. At bottom corners, a small stack of antique blank-backed playing cards, quill and closed ledger, deliberately few props. Actual physical room architecture, intimate scale. Handmade painterly fantasy illustration with detailed natural textures, crisp selective edges and gentle depth; sober and lived-in, no palace, no grandiose luxury. The background must remain visibly atmospheric without covering the card collection UI. No person, no words, no UI panels, no lettering, no logos or watermark. The dark oak table occupies lower third, remaining calm and dark. Finish should harmonize with realistic fantasy illustrations, avoid glossy game render, blue wash and excessive haze.
reference: User screenshots of private collection and established shop/stable/pet-shop presentation
